South Korea is one of those places that stays with you long after you leave. Whether you are planning a trip to South Korea, the experience is nothing short of transformative.

## Best Time to Visit

The ideal time to explore South Korea depends on what you want to experience. Summer offers long days perfect for outdoor adventures.

## Top Attractions

- Famous attractions that define South Korea
- Hidden gems only locals know about
- Historical sites that tell the story of South Korea
- Scenic viewpoints for unforgettable photos

## Local Cuisine

No trip to South Korea is complete without sampling the local food. From street-side vendors to fine dining establishments, the culinary scene reflects the region's rich heritage and innovative spirit.

## Getting Around

Renting a vehicle gives you the freedom to discover South Korea at your own pace, especially for remote attractions.

## Where to Stay

Book early during peak season to secure the best places to stay in South Korea.
